hooks.command:
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path') && if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then python3 - "$FILE" << 'PYSCRIPT'
import sys, os
f = sys.argv[1]
if not os.path.exists(f): exit(0)
with open(f, 'rb') as file: content = file.read()
if b'\xe2\x80\x98' in content or b'\xe2\x80\x99' in content:
  new_content = content.replace(b'\xe2\x80\x98', b"'").replace(b'\xe2\x80\x99', b"'")
  with open(f, 'wb') as file: file.write(new_content)
PYSCRIPT
fi
